messages.subject: error in reading cdf file with new version
parts:
Hi,
I'm getting a strange error using code that use to work before the last
revision (and also before I wiped everything clean, so that's a bit
confounding). Basically when I try to read in my 'core' cdf, I'm getting
an error, but my other types of cdfs do not give an error. The only
difference I could think of between the cdfs is that the 'core' cdf has
multiple versions, 'xxx,core,yyy.cdf" while the other two are the first
occasion of them. But another cdf 'full' also has two versions and does
not have the problem either (and indeed the ensb version also has the
monocell version). I have also downloaded the patch and had not tried
the code with the new version before the patch, if that matters.
Best,
Elizabeth

>
cdfCore<-AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType(paste(chipType,"core,A20070914,EP",sep=","))
Error in match(x, table, nomatch = 0) :
formal argument "nomatch" matched by multiple actual arguments

cdfMain<-AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType(paste(chipType,"main,A20070914,EP",sep=","))

cdfEnsb<-AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType(paste(chipType,"U-Ensembl47,G-Affy",sep=","))

Okay, I may need to withdraw this and look at my installation, because
something more serious is going on. I'm also getting errors on
AffymetrixCelSet$fromFiles code from before:

> csNTissue <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromFiles(path)
Error: attempt to apply non-function

I *have* loaded the library...

When I wiped clean my environment, could I have broken something
serious? I didn't think that was possible...I'll have to sort this out
a bit.

Best,
Elizabeth
